name: Serizawa Yoko
source: A chemistry teacher who recently joined Kohnodai. She has her doubts about the culture of self-governance in Kohnodai Academy, and she personally would prefer it if the students were more disciplined. Winds up lecturing her students often because she really cares about them. In other words, she’s an overly diligent teacher who always takes her role as an educator seriously.
